newsitem.title: FINLAND: METRA NEW DIESEL J/V NAMED WARTSILA NSD.
newsitem.headline: METRA NEW DIESEL J/V NAMED WARTSILA NSD.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Metra Oy Ab said in a statement on Wednesday its new joint diesel venture with Italy's Fincantieri would be named Wartsila NSD Oy Ab or Wartsila NSD Corporation in English.
"The company will be registered in Finland and its corporate management will move from Strasbourg to the Zurich area at a date to be announced later," Metra said.

It also said the negotiations between Metra and Fincantieri on creating the new unit by join the operations of Wartsila Diesel, New Sulzer Diesel, Diesel Recerche and Grandi Motori were proceeding as planned, it said.
Metra on September 12 unveiled a tentative agreement on the arrangement the merge the diesel units into a new company in which Metra would have the majority and Fincantieri up to 15 percent.
